tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, taken live for real customer bookings.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) with secure authentication, separating admin and end-user workflows across the platform.
Built a full-stack trading platform across three services: marketing site, trading dashboard, and Express API with JWT-based authentication.
Deployed the full stack using Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas as three independently deployed services communicating over HTTP.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to express my interest in the Full Stack Developer Intern position at Pitchline. As an MCA student at PES University with hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to building your voice-based conversational sales AI agent MVP. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL that was taken live for real customer bookings, implementing secure authentication and role-based access control. Additionally, in my personal projects such as Zenvest, I developed a full-stack trading platform across multiple services using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, integrating third-party APIs with server-side proxy caching and deploying via Vercel and Render. My background in developing full-stack web applications aligns directly with your need for a hands-on intern to help shape your application's foundation. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how my technical background matches your requirements.

screening_answers.why_this_company: Pitchline is building a voice-based conversational sales AI agent, an ambitious AI-powered web app aimed at solving meaningful problems in the B2B space that is currently in its MVP stage with strong early demand.
screening_answers.why_this_role: The role requires a hands-on Full Stack Developer Intern to work closely on bringing the voice-based conversational sales AI agent MVP to life and shaping its foundation, which matches my experience building full-stack applications with Node.js, Express, and modern web frameworks.
screening_answers.why_you: I bring hands-on full-stack experience from my internship at Sunflower Trip where I built a production-ready system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, as well as project experience building MERN stack applications like Zenvest and StaySphere.
screening_answers.availability: Availability should be confirmed with the candidate.
screening_answers.relocation: Relocation preference should be confirmed with the candidate.
screening_answers.relevant_technology_experience: JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, React.js, Angular, MongoDB, MySQL, REST APIs, Git, Azure, AWS

application_strategy: Emphasize full-stack development experience from the Sunflower Trip internship using Node.js, Express, and MySQL.
Mention project experience building scalable architectures like Zenvest and StaySphere.
Note that while the job description lists the position as remote in the pay section, the header lists remote as false, so work mode requirements should be clarified during screening.
Align the expected stipend preference of ₹25,000/month with the posted range of ₹20,000 - ₹30,000/month.
